title: Dragon Dad Rebuild
author: YURIY K.
desc:
A 24-week strength and fitness rebuilding program designed for men over 55 who want to regain muscle, build strength, improve cardiovascular fitness, and stay active as they age.
Key Objectives:
- Build Muscle: Gradually increase muscle mass and strength.
- Improve Endurance: Build cardiovascular fitness through cycling.
- Maintain Mobility: Improve flexibility, balance, and joint function.
- Support Recovery: Prevent overtraining through controlled intensity and scheduled deload weeks.
- Build Consistency: Establish a sustainable fitness routine without burnout.

Training Structure: Three strength sessions, two cycling days, one mobility day, and one rest day per week.

Progression: Three weeks of gradual training progression followed by one lighter recovery week, repeated across 24 weeks.

The Ultimate Goal: Build a stronger body, maintain independence, and stay physically capable for decades to come.

'Not trying to turn back the clock. Just making sure it keeps running strong'.
